passages.text: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward. For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
passages.note: Perseverance when tempted to give up

passages.text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
passages.note: Hope and faith in what is unseen

passages.text: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
